title: Story: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
summary: Ali Baba discovers the secret of the "Open Sesame" cave; his greedy brother Kasim gets trapped, and the clever servant Morgiana outwits the thieves three times. Present tense, short sentences, a little Perfekt.
phrases: He doesn't want to be greedy. |
Where did you get the gold? |
Don't be afraid. I have a plan. |
He looks like a rich merchant. |
lines: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.
Ali Baba is a poor man.
He lives in a small town.
He has a brother. His brother's name is Kasim.
He has a big house and lots of goods.
He works in the forest. He collects wood.
He has only a few donkeys.
Every day Ali Baba goes into the forest.
He cuts wood and brings it home.
But Ali Baba is a good man.
One day Ali Baba is in the forest.
He quickly climbs up a tree.
The thieves go to a big rock.
The leader stands in front of the rock.
After a while the thieves come back.
They come out of the cave.
Ali Baba stays in the tree.
Ali Baba waits a little longer.
Then he slowly climbs down from the tree.
He is afraid, but he is also curious.
He goes to the big rock.
Ali Baba stands in front of the rock and thinks.
He carefully goes into the cave.
Inside he sees lots of treasure.
There is gold, silver and beautiful things.
Ali Baba can hardly believe it.
He takes only a little gold.
He doesn't want to be greedy.
In front of the rock he says: "Close, Sesame."
Ali Baba is happy. He goes home.
He shows his wife the gold.
She asks: "Where did you get the gold?"
He tells her about the forest, the thieves and the cave.
But she also wants to know how much gold there is.
She says: "We need a pair of scales."
She goes to Kasim's wife and borrows some scales.
She thinks: "Why do they need scales?"
She puts a little piece of wax under the scales.
Ali Baba's wife weighs the gold.
Then she brings the scales back.
A small gold coin stays stuck to the wax.
Kasim's wife sees the gold coin.
She is amazed and also a little jealous.
She shows it to her husband, Kasim.
He goes to Ali Baba and says: "Where did you get the gold?"
In the end Ali Baba tells him the secret of the cave.
The next day Kasim goes into the forest.
He takes lots of donkeys with him.
He wants to fetch a lot of gold.
In the cave he sees a huge amount of gold and lots of treasure.
He takes as much gold as possible.
Then he wants to go back out.
Kasim can no longer remember the right word.
But he can't find a way out.
He shouts loudly for help, but nobody hears him.
After a while the thieves come back.
They want to look at their treasure.
The leader says the word and the rock opens.
The thieves go into the cave.
They think someone has given away their secret.
They attack Kasim and kill him.
Then they leave his body in the cave.
After that the thieves leave the cave again, taking nothing with them.
Ali Baba's wife is worried too.
He takes his donkeys and goes into the forest.
Ali Baba comes to the big rock.
Ali Baba slowly goes into the cave.
Inside it is dark and quiet.
Then Ali Baba sees his brother.
Kasim is lying on the ground.
But he has to be quick.
The thieves could come at any moment.
He carefully lays the body on a donkey.
It is night. Nobody sees him.
Back in town he brings the body into Kasim's house.
Ali Baba says: "Be quiet. This is a big secret."
Ali Baba thinks: "We have a big problem."
Ali Baba thinks for a long time.
Morgiana is a clever servant in Kasim's house.
Then she says: "Don't be afraid. I have a plan."
She is looking for a tailor.
She finds an old man. He is a tailor.
Morgiana says: "Please come with me. I have work for you."
But Morgiana says: "You mustn't see anything."
The tailor is surprised, but he says nothing.
Morgiana leads him to the house.
In the house she shows him Kasim's body.
She says: "You have to sew this."
The tailor is afraid, but he does the work.
He carefully sews the body together.
Then Morgiana takes the tailor back again.
The tailor doesn't know where he was.
Morgiana gives him money. He goes away.
The next day everyone says: "Kasim is ill."
After a while they say: "Kasim is dead."
A few days later the thieves come back to the cave.
They want to look at their treasure.
They see that someone has been in the cave.
The body isn't there any more.
They say: "We have to find this person."
Then he says: "I'll go into town. I'll find the man."
Now he looks like an ordinary man.
In town he asks lots of people.
He says: "I'm looking for a rich man. Maybe he has new money."
People say: "Kasim was rich. But now he's dead."
At last he finds the tailor.
The tailor says: "I did some work for a man. I sewed a body together."
The tailor doesn't know where the house is.
But he says: "Maybe I can find the way."
Then he blindfolds the tailor, just like Morgiana did.
The tailor walks slowly through the streets.
The thief makes a mark on the door.
He thinks: "Now I'll find the house again."
Then she sees the mark on Ali Baba's house.
She makes the same mark on lots of other houses in the street.
Now lots of doors have the same mark.
In the evening the thieves come back.
They are looking for the house.
Lots of houses have the same mark.
They don't know which house is the right one.
She thinks: "Now we're safe, but only for today."
The leader of the thieves is very angry.
He says: "We'll make a new plan."
He thinks for a long time.
The next day he goes into town.
Now he looks like a rich merchant.
He brings lots of big oil jars with him.
There are lots of jars on a cart.
But there isn't only oil in the jars.
Thieves are hiding in many of the jars.
Only one jar is really full of oil.
The leader goes to Ali Baba's house.
The man says: "Good evening. I'm a merchant. I've had a long journey. Can I stay here overnight?"
He says: "Yes, of course. Come in."
The donkeys and the jars stay in the courtyard.
In the night it is quiet.
The thieves in the jars wait.
Morgiana opens a jar very carefully.
Suddenly she hears a voice: "Is it time?"
She goes quietly back into the kitchen.
She makes the oil very hot.
The night is quiet. Everyone is asleep.
Morgiana carefully carries the hot oil outside.
She opens one jar after another.
In every jar there is a thief.
Morgiana pours hot oil into the jars.
In the end all the thieves in the jars are dead.
Only the leader is still alive.
He is waiting for a signal.
He looks at the jars. Everything is quiet.
In the morning Ali Baba sees the jars.
Ali Baba knows: Morgiana is very clever and very brave.
The leader of the thieves is still alive.
His heart is full of rage.
He wants to find Ali Baba and kill him.
After a while he comes back to town.
Now he looks like a rich man.
He goes to Ali Baba's son.
He says: "I'm a merchant. I'd like to be your friend."
One day Ali Baba's son invites the man to dinner.
The man comes into the house.
Then she understands: "That's the leader of the thieves."
In the evening she dances for the guests.
During the dance Morgiana comes closer to the man.
Ali Baba is frightened and says: "What are you doing?"
Morgiana says calmly: "This is the leader of the thieves. He wants to kill you."
And they live happily ever after.

focus.title: Imperative
points: Command with du: the verb stem (+ sometimes -e): Öffne dich! · Schließe dich! · Komm herein!
sein and haben are irregular: Sei leise! · Hab keine Angst!
Plural (ihr): Seid bereit! — polite: Kommen Sie herein!
Separable verbs: Komm bitte mit!

focus.title: Reflexive verbs
points: sich verstecken: Er versteckt sich. · sich öffnen / sich schließen: Der Felsen öffnet sich.
sich erinnern an + Akkusativ: Kasim kann sich nicht an das Wort erinnern.
sich freuen: Er freut sich sehr.
The pronoun follows the subject: ich … mich · du … dich · er/sie … sich

focus.title: Modal verbs
points: wollen (to want): Er will viel Gold holen.
müssen (must): Er muss schnell sein. · können: Die Räuber können jeden Moment kommen.
dürfen with a negative = must not: Du darfst nichts sehen.
The main verb is always an infinitive at the end of the sentence.

focus.title: Dativ: jemandem etwas
points: zeigen: Er zeigt seiner Frau das Gold. (to his wife)
geben: Morgiana gibt ihm Geld. · erzählen: Er erzählt ihr alles.
helfen: Er hilft dem Mann. · vertrauen: Der Sohn vertraut ihm.
Dativ: der → dem · die → der · das → dem · plural → den …n

focus.title: Genitiv & von
points: With names just add -s: Kasims Frau · Ali Babas Haus · Ali Babas Sohn
With von (more colloquial): das Haus von Kasim · der Körper von Kasim
Genitiv with an article: die Augen des Schneiders · der Anführer der Räuber
In everyday speech von + Dativ is more common.
